# camenc zero-copy: verified on the board (2026-10-05)

## What the arrangement is

The encoder is given the buffer the capture driver demosaiced into, instead of
the application copying the frame into a buffer of the encoder's.

Three pieces, all in `contest2026_062_PharosTech`:

| File | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c` | `.alloc`/`.free` hooks on the imgdata ops, so the capture frame heap comes from the DMA heap — the one heap on the part that is identity-mapped, hence the only one whose addresses are physical |
| `chips/rk3576/vepu/rk3576_vepu_codec.c` | `vepu_buffer_is_ours` → `vepu_buffer_usable` + `vepu_buffer_reachable`: the test became the hardware's own requirement (64-byte aligned at both ends, wholly below 4 GiB) rather than "did this driver allocate it". Output side accepts `USERPTR` |
| `app/camenc/camenc_main.c` | `g_zerocopy` decides once per stream; `camenc_setup_import` asks for containers without backing store, `camenc_queue_import` names the camera buffer's address per frame |

The reasoning that made this possible: the encoder's MMU is in pass-through, so
the addresses in its registers have to be physical. Asking "is this my
allocation" refused the camera's buffer by construction, and that was the only
thing standing in the way.

## Verified, and how

Temporarily added a `-z` switch meaning *refuse to run unless the frames are
encoded where they lie*: the two places that used to fall back to copying became
hard errors naming which precondition failed, and the copy branch became
unreachable.

| Run | Result |
| --- | --- |
| default mode (3 = 1280x720@30) | stream played, picture correct |
| `-m 1` (1296x960@30) | stream played, picture correct |
| `-m 0` (1920x1080) | **refused** — encoder pads to 1088 rows, camera gives 1080 |
| `-m 1 -W 1280` (crop) | **refused** — widths disagree |

The negatives are what make the positives mean anything: a flag that was not
wired up would have shown the same "it plays" as a flag that was.

`-z` was then removed, as agreed. The source is back to the fallback, and the
firmware was rebuilt so no trace of the switch remains in either.

## The technique, for reuse

This is the pattern to reach for when two code paths produce the same observable
result and only a counter tells them apart:

1. Make the path you do not want **unreachable**, rather than merely unlikely.
2. Turn its precondition into a hard refusal that names what failed.
3. Run the cases that must refuse. If they do not, the switch is not wired and
   the positive run proved nothing.

It works without a serial console, which matters here — see `AGENTS.md`.

## Open

- **The performance result was never captured.** The verification was structural,
  not quantitative: `copy 0/0`, `sum` against `period`, and the frame rate were
  not read. So it is *not* yet known whether the reclaimed copy (measured at
  5.8 ms/frame) brought the single core from ~27.4 fps to the 31.25 fps the
  camera offers. The arithmetic says it should (34.9 − 5.8 = 29.1 ms < 32 ms),
  and that arithmetic is the only basis so far.
- **1920x1080 still copies**, by design. Making it zero-copy would need the
  capture driver to write the chroma plane at `v_stride` rows rather than at the
  picture height — see the magenta-band note in `board-and-build.md`.
- The camenc-side guard mirrors the driver's rule but is missing the
  `size % 64` half of it. All four modes' input sizes happen to be 64-aligned, so
  it is latent rather than live. Worth closing when the area is next touched.

# camenc thread-model refactor: state and plan

## The route, and why

camenc is the contest sample delivery. It will run SMP eventually, but **not
yet**: SMP is cheap to switch on and would dull the incentive to optimise, and
the compute-heavy part (the NEON demosaic) is already at its limit — making that
faster means redesigning it for several cores, not turning SMP on.

So the order is: **get the concurrency right first, then look at SMP.**

## The constraint that shapes everything

Single core (`CONFIG_NCPUS=1`). Measured on 1296x960: the VICAP worker needs
22.9 ms/frame, camenc's non-waiting work 12 ms — 34.9 ms against a 32 ms frame
period, hence ~27.4 fps.

**Threading does not reduce that total.** Splitting work across threads on one
core buys structure and deadline protection, not throughput. Getting the frame
rate back needs *less work*, which is what zero-copy (5.8 ms) and reading the raw
frame where it lies (7.8 ms) were for.

## Scheduler facts (checked, not assumed)

| | Value | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| camenc | priority **100** | `CONFIG_EXAMPLES_CAMENC_PRIORITY` |
| VICAP worker | priority **100** | `CONFIG_SCHED_LPWORKPRIORITY`; queued on `LPWORK` in `rk3576_vicap.c` |
| HPWORK | 192 | system, unrelated to the camera |
| cores | 1 | `CONFIG_NCPUS` |
| round-robin slice | 200 ms | `CONFIG_RR_INTERVAL`; effectively "yield at blocking points" |

★ The plan carried over from the earlier memory said "raise the thread above
LPWORK because LPWORK is currently the lowest priority". That is **not** the
situation: LPWORK sits at 100, the same as camenc. The two are peers today.

Also: **do not raise LPWORK.** It is shared by every driver in the system. Give
the encode thread a higher number instead, and put the network thread below.

| Thread | Proposed |
| --- | --- |
| encode + mux + AE | 110 |
| VICAP worker (LPWORK) | 100 — unchanged |
| network | 90 |
| control | 90, event-driven |

The encode thread spends most of its time blocked inside the encoder's `QBUF`,
so priority 110 does not squeeze the VICAP worker's 22.9 ms; it preempts only
for the ~4 ms of mux, emit and 3A, which is exactly the deadline protection
wanted.

## The four threads

| Thread | Job |
| --- | --- |
| 1 VICAP worker | already exists (kernel LPWORK): demosaic + 3A measurement, writes VEPU-geometry NV12 into the DMA-heap pool, cleans cache |
| 2 encode + mux + AE | dequeue camera frame → hand to encoder (blocks until the VEPU ISR) → dequeue bitstream → mux → emit; run the AE/AWB decision each frame, which is a natural per-frame beat |
| 3 network | non-blocking accept/recv/send plus HTTP, fed from a **bounded** segment queue, dropping oldest |
| 4 control | policy only; starts 2 and 3; mode changes go quiesce → reconfigure → resume |

## Where the code stands

The main loop is `for (; i < frames; i++)` in `camenc_main.c`, and one pass is:

```
mode-change check → DQBUF camera → [copy] → QBUF encoder (blocks ~24 ms)
→ DQBUF encoder → mux → emit (file + WS publish) → 3A → QBUF camera back
→ every 100 frames, report → camenc_ws_poll (non-blocking, at frame end)
```

Stages are accounted as `camera copy encode drain mux file clients serve`.

| Step | State |
| --- | --- |
| 1 pool into the DMA heap, VEPU geometry | done |
| 2 ownership of `vepu_check_buf` | done |
| 3 camenc wired to it (zero-copy) | done, **verified on the board** — see `camenc-zerocopy.md` |
| 4 split thread 2; pool state machine | not started |
| 5 split thread 3 + bounded segment queue | not started |
| 6 thread 4 control; mode switch quiesce/resume | not started |

### Notes that will save time on step 4

- The "pool state machine" is mostly already V4L2: `DQBUF` means held, `QBUF`
  means returned. Of the intended `free → filled → encoding → free`, the
  `encoding` state is just "camenc is holding it". What genuinely has to be added
  is drop counting and the rule that a missing free slot drops a frame instead of
  blocking. Do not invent an abstraction the driver already provides.
- `camenc_ws.c` is already shaped as a non-blocking event loop, so step 5 is
  mostly about *where* `camenc_ws_poll` is called from, plus turning
  `camenc_ws_publish` into a push onto the bounded queue.
- `camenc_ui_command` already only records intent (it runs inside the poll
  callback); the loop acts on it at the top of a frame. That shape survives the
  split as-is.
- A mode change must go through the existing `rk3576_vicap_reconfigure` and
  `rk3576_csi_host_set_lane_rate`. The uninit/init path **hung the board and
  tripped the watchdog** the one time it was exercised.

### Honest expectation for step 4

On one core the split should be worth roughly **0 fps**. It is structure,
deadline protection and SMP readiness. If the frame rate is the goal, the
work-reduction steps are the ones that matter.

# Board, sensor modes, and build facts

## Sensor modes — current indices

From `contest2026_062_PharosTech/drivers/include/ov5647.h`, which is the only
source of truth. **Several earlier notes have these wrong** (they said `-m 2`
was 640x480 and `-m 3` was 1080p); re-check, do not copy.

| idx | mode | zero-copy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | 1920x1080@15 | no — the encoder pads to 1088 rows |
| 1 | 1296x960@30 | yes |
| 2 | 1296x960@15 | yes |
| **3** | **1280x720@30** — `CAMENC_DEFAULT_MODE` | yes |
| 4 | 1280x720@15 | yes |
| 5 | 640x480@60 | yes |
| 6 | 640x480@30 | yes |

Zero-copy holds whenever the encoder's luma plane is exactly the picture height,
which is every mode whose height is a multiple of 16 — all but 1080p.

The board carries a second table in `drivers/include/ov5647.h`'s consumers; the
`-m` index the application takes is an index into that table, not a resolution.

## Build and flash

```sh
./build.sh contest2026_062_PharosTech/configs/camera --cmake
# firmware: cmake_out/contest2026_062_PharosTech_camera/nuttx.bin
```

Incremental builds need the toolchain on `PATH` (`aarch64-none-elf-ar` is
invoked by bare name) and `CCACHE_DISABLE=1` when the sandbox cannot write
`~/.cache/ccache`.

Firmware is flashed by hand on another machine. N-Boot A/B: the new `nuttx.bin`
replaces `nuttx_a.img`; SD-card boot is the alternative.

## Traps that have already cost time

- **`defconfig` edits are not re-expanded into `.config`.** CMake regenerates it
  only when the file is missing or its *path* changes, not its contents. An
  incremental build then silently uses the old value. Fix: `rm -rf
  cmake_out/<cfg>` and rebuild, then confirm the option in
  `cmake_out/<cfg>/include/nuttx/config.h`. This trap disguises itself as "my
  code change broke it".
- **Editing `web/page.html` does not rebuild the firmware.** It reaches the
  binary through `.incbin`, which the dependency scan cannot see, so the board
  keeps serving the old page and it looks like browser caching. Check with
  `grep -ao "<a string from the new page>" cmake_out/<cfg>/nuttx`.
- **A stale binary looks like a stale source.** Before flashing, compare
  `nuttx.bin`'s mtime against every source, or just run ninja and confirm it has
  nothing to do.

## The encoder's frame geometry, and the magenta band

The encoder reads a source buffer as luma over `y_stride × v_stride` with the
chroma plane at **`y_stride × v_stride`** — the *allocated* height, not the
picture height. `v_stride = align(height, 16)`.

This bit 1920x1080: the picture is 1080 rows, `v_stride` is 1088, so the chroma
plane belongs at `1920×1088 = 2088960`. Code that used `height × stride`
(`2073600`) put it 8 rows early, leaving the bottom 8 chroma rows never written —
which a decoder shows as a **magenta band across the bottom 16 lines**, reading
whatever the memory last held. Every other mode has `align(h,16) == h`, so the
two agree and the bug stayed hidden.

**`src_size`/`dst_size` are allocation sizes, not picture sizes.** Anything that
fills NV12 as `w*h*3/2` will break on a height that is not a multiple of 16.

The capture driver writes exactly the picture geometry — luma stride `width`,
chroma at `width × height` — so for 16-multiple heights the two devices already
agree, which is what makes zero-copy possible at all.

## Cache

The VEPU DMA **does not snoop**. The contract is explicit maintenance, and both
sides already do it: VICAP cleans the demosaiced frame after the demosaic, VEPU
cleans the source before a job and invalidates the destination after. The DMA
heap is normal, cacheable, identity-mapped memory with 64-byte lines, so a buffer
must be 64-byte aligned at both ends, or the maintenance touches its neighbours.

## Streaming

- The WebSocket carries fragmented MP4, one fragment per frame.
- **Dropping a fragment breaks every following P picture**, and a decoder shows
  that as a frame of garbage rather than one missing frame. The recovery is to
  mark the client `waiting` and skip until the next key fragment; the encoder's
  key/P flags make that work.
- `CAMENC_WS_MAX_SEGMENT` is 512 KiB.
- camenc asks the encoder for groups of **15** pictures (`CAMENC_DEFAULT_GOP`);
  the driver's own default is 2 (`RK3576_VEPU_DEFAULT_GOP`). Measured on a drawn
  source: groups of 4 are 51% of the rate of groups of 2.
- The encoder has **no rate control** — it runs at a fixed QP, so the only lever
  on bitrate is the quantiser.

Three files carry the zero-copy work and are **staged but not committed**:
`app/camenc/camenc_main.c`, `chips/rk3576/rk3576_vicap.c`,
`chips/rk3576/vepu/rk3576_vepu_codec.c`.

text:
我把你的模型和代码对了一遍。**整体结构我认为是对的**，而且有一处你实际上推翻了之前 Copilot 的定稿——我觉得推翻得对，理由比原来那条更硬。下面按"需要细化"的程度排。

## 1. 你这次把 AE 放线程4，推翻了之前的"AE 放线程2"

之前 Copilot 的定稿是 **AE 放线程2**，理由是"避免线程1 每帧通知两个消费者"。你这次放线程4。

**我认同你的版本**，但关键不在"谁通知谁"，而在**线程2 的 deadline 余量**：

- 线程2 的链路是 `QBUF编码器(实测 23958µs) → DQBUF → mux(3.3ms)`，合计 **~27.3ms / 32ms 周期**，只剩 4.7ms 余量。
- AE 的 I2C 写（`VIDIOC_S_CTRL`）如果放在线程2 里，是**直接吃掉这 4.7ms**。
- 放线程4 则完全不进这条链。

注意这里**不是"省出了 CPU"**——单核总账是固定的，零拷贝后大约是 `worker 22.9 + mux 3.3 + 网络 2.9 + 3A ≈ 29~30ms < 32ms`，怎么排都在预算内。放线程4 买到的纯粹是**线程2 的 deadline 余量**。

现有代码的注释其实已经摸到了这个意图（"the cost of that inside the capture-to-encode path is time the encoder sits idle"），但它是靠"把 3A 挪到编码之后"来回避的——那是单线程下的将就。分线程之后，这个意图变成结构上保证。

## 2. 唤醒源应该是**线程2**，不是线程1，而且时机在入队之后

线程2 在 QBUF 里睡 ~24ms 等 VEPU。这期间它不占 CPU。让它 `sem_post` 一下把线程4 叫醒，由线程4 去做 3A——**线程1 依然只通知一个消费者**，你关心的那条约束自动满足。

具体位置：**QBUF 返回之前**（即刚把帧交给编码器）就 post，让线程4 的决策和编码硬件工作重叠。线程2 post 完立刻阻塞，不损失什么。

## 3. `sequence` 字段改变了唤醒的语义 —— 这条让"AE 放线程4"从"可以"变成"明显更好"

`cam3a_stats_s.sequence` 的注释是这么写的：

> Bumped once per measured frame. Comparing it against the value from a previous call is how a caller tells "a new frame has arrived" from "I am looking at the same measurement again" — which matters because **acting twice on one measurement doubles the correction**.

也就是说 `CAM3A_GET_STATS` **不是消费式的**，而唤醒只是**提示、不是契约**：

- 丢一次唤醒 → 决策晚一帧，不会漏动作（下一次 `sequence` 会告诉你）；
- 多醒一次 → 靠 `sequence` 比对发现"还是上次那个测量"，直接返回，不会重复施加。

⇒ 线程4 因此可以在一次唤醒里追平错过的测量，或者明确只处理最新一次。**这是 CPU 预算的一个调节旋钮，而不是一个正确性风险**，正是"AE 独立成一个线程"能成立的前提。

## 4. 但 `/dev/cam3a` 只有 ioctl —— 线程4 没有可阻塞的对象

```c
static const struct file_operations g_rk3576_vicap_cam3a_fops = {
  .ioctl = rk3576_vicap_cam3a_ioctl,
};
```

没有 `.poll`、没有 `.read`、连 `.open`/`.close` 都没有。所以线程4 **必须**被别处唤醒（即上面那条），无法自己阻塞在测量上。两条路要选一条：

| | 做法 | 代价 |
|---|---|---|
| **A** | 线程2 每帧 post | 零改动；但 AE 的命脉挂在编码路径上——线程2 出错或停摆，AE 静默停掉 |
| **B** | 给 cam3a 加 `.poll`，工作线程发布测量时 `sem_post`（非阻塞，不违反"线程1 绝不阻塞"） | 一处驱动改动；AE 与编码路径彻底解耦，编码挂了 AE 照跑 |

我倾向 **B**，但这取决于你愿不愿意为它动驱动。

## 5. WB 增益是"设置并保持"，不是每帧推送 —— 但工作线程要锁存

`CAM3A_SET_WB` 的语义是 gains 一直有效 **until a later `CAM3A_SET_WB` changes them**。所以线程4 **只在控制律产生变化时**才写，不是每帧一个 ioctl；每帧成本只剩一次 `GET_STATS`（和偶尔的曝光/增益 I2C 写）。

**但有一处必须钉死**：工作线程应该在**每次去马赛克开始时锁存**当前 WB 增益。否则线程4 的写入落在"这一帧的 demosaic 还没开始"或"已经开始了"之间会抖动，**环路延迟在 1 帧和 2 帧之间跳**。3A 那份记忆里已经记过"阻尼/死区"这类收敛问题，延迟抖动是同一类。这是工作线程一侧的一行改动，但不定下来就会变成"偶发收敛慢"。

## 6. 零拷贝白捡了 3.3ms 的掉帧余量：相机缓冲可以在 mux **之前**归还

现在的顺序是 `QBUF编码器 → DQBUF → mux → emit → 才 QBUF 相机`，相机缓冲被攥住 ~27.3ms。

但**编码器一旦 DQBUF 返回，它就不再读那块帧了**——源帧不是参考帧（参考帧是重建缓冲），而 mux 处理的是**码流**不是画面。

⇒ 把"归还相机缓冲"提到 mux 之前，持有时间从 ~27.3ms 降到 ~24ms。在 3 缓冲的池子里这就是实打实的余量。**零拷贝之前做不到**（画面还得先拷走），现在可以了。

## 7. 线程2→线程3 的交接：文件和 WS 的丢弃策略不同，**不能共用一个队列**

`camenc_emit` 现在是同步回调：

- 文件：`fwrite` **无条件、失败即 `-EIO`**；
- WS：`camenc_ws_publish` 塞不下就丢，并把该客户端置 `waiting`。

挪到线程3 之后，如果两者共用一个有界队列，**队列一满文件也会丢帧**——而"文件无条件写每一帧"正是之前用来否证"WS 丢帧导致洋红"那个假设的诊断依据。丢了它，以后同类问题就少一件工具。

⇒ 需要明确：文件侧**无损**、WS 侧**可丢**。要么两条队列各自策略，要么接受文件也丢并放弃那个诊断属性。

⇒ 还有一条硬要求：**丢帧必须能让编码器出一个 IDR**，否则客户端要等满一个 GOP（现在是 15）才恢复。

⇒ 段缓冲建议**环形槽位 + 队列存下标**，不要每段一次动态分配和拷贝。

## 8. "丢 oldest" 和 V4L2 实际行为不一致，而且这个选择值得显式做一次

之前记的是"有界环 + 丢 oldest"。实际上驱动在**没有空槽时丢的是刚到达的那一帧**，已经在队列里的照留。

对直播预览，**丢 oldest 才是低延迟的正解**：线程2 醒来时应该把队列**抽干到最新一帧**，把过期的立刻还给相机，而不是按顺序慢慢编。零拷贝让"还回去"变免费，所以这个策略现在代价很低。

但它和 AE 的收敛速度相互作用（抽干 = 少喂几帧给环路），要一起定。

## 9. 模式切换：**quiesce/resume，不要重建线程**

你说"重启线程和外设"。两点：

- **外设**必须走 `rk3576_vicap_reconfigure` + `rk3576_csi_host_set_lane_rate`。`uninit/init` 那条路**实测把板子挂死并触发过 WDT**，不能碰。
- **线程没有理由重建**：fd 不变、栈不变、优先级不变。真正要重置的是**数据**：muxer 的流（新 init segment、新时间轴）、WS 客户端（等新 init）、帧池（几何变了）。重建线程只是额外引入一类失败。

⇒ 线程2/3 应该**穿过**模式切换存活，只是被静默。

⚠ **有一个必须先验证的点**：线程2 很可能正阻塞在 `DQBUF` 里，而 `rk3576_vicap_stop_capture()` 已知**不等在途帧**。那么 `STREAMOFF` 能不能把阻塞中的 `DQBUF` 唤醒并返回错误？

- 能 → 线程4 可以强行拆资源；

/****************************************************************************
 * The 3A control plane for the capture path.
 *
 * Automatic exposure, gain and white balance are decisions rather than
 * mechanisms.  How bright a picture should be, and which of noise, motion
 * blur and frame rate to spend getting there, depends on what the camera is
 * being used for -- so the decision belongs to the application.  This
 * interface is how it is reached: the capture driver measures and applies,
 * the application decides.
 *
 * WHY THE MEASUREMENT IS IN THE DRIVER
 *
 * The channel sums come out of the demosaic loop, which is already reading
 * every RAW sample, so measuring a frame costs nothing extra.  That is the
 * lesser reason.  The greater one is that the measurement cannot be taken
 * anywhere else.
 *
 * The sums have to be taken *before* the white balance gains are applied: a
 * loop that measured after would read its own output, because a gain that is
 * already too high raises that channel's average and so lowers the
 * correction it asks for, and the loop settles on the square root of the
 * gain it was supposed to find.
 *
 * And they cannot be recovered from the output.  Once the frame is NV12 the
 * colour it carried has been corrected away: an application holding a white
 * balanced picture cannot tell a grey scene from a strongly cast one, which
 * is exactly the distinction white balance exists to make.  Handing the
 * application RAW instead would mean either giving up the fused
 * single-pass demosaic or doing the demosaic twice.
 *
 * WHY THIS IS A DEVICE AND NOT CONTROLS ON /dev/videoN
 *
 * Exposure and gain belong to the sensor, which the capture device's control
 * path reaches; white balance belongs to the capture driver, which it does
 * not.  Folding the two together would mean either a gain stored in the
 * sensor driver that the sensor has no use for, or a sensor driver that
 * knows about the SoC's video block.  A separate device keeps each control
 * where the hardware it programs lives.

查清了。直接回答：**它不写 I2C，一行都不碰。** 这个设备不是"参数进、I2C 出"的管道，这是最容易记错的一点。

## `/dev/cam3a` 是什么

是独立字符设备，但**不是通用驱动**——它由 VICAP 驱动自己注册（`rk3576_vicap_cam3a_register()`），`g_rk3576_vicap_cam3a_fops` **只有 `.ioctl`**，没有 open/close/read/poll。

头文件把定位写得很明确：

> exposure and gain are not here at all, because they are the sensor's and reachable through the ordinary V4L2 controls on the capture device.

三个 ioctl 的真实分工：

| ioctl | 方向 | 实际做什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `CAM3A_GET_STATS` | 驱动 → 应用 | 在 `irqlock` 下把**最后一帧的测量**拷出来（sequence、几何、count、三通道和、当前 WB、awb_active） |
| `CAM3A_SET_WB` | 应用 → 驱动 | 校验三个增益（下限 1，上限 `RK3576_VICAP_WB_HARD_MAX`），存进 `priv->wb[]`，**并把 `awb_active` 清掉** |
| `CAM3A_SET_AWB` | 应用 → 驱动 | 只改 `awb_active` |

## 它确实还管别的事，有三件

1. **测量的唯一出口**——这其实是它的头号职责。测量在去马赛克循环里顺手算出（在施加 WB 增益**之前**），只能从这里取走。
2. **WB 增益的施加点**。增益存进驱动状态后，由去马赛克的 NEON 路径取用（`vdupq_n_s16(priv->wb[i] << 2)`）。**这是 VICAP 的操作，不是 sensor 的**——所以它根本去不了 I2C，只能在这里生效。
3. **WB 的归属权**。驱动自己有一个 AWB 环（`rk3576_vicap_wb_update`，两个 demosaicer 都调它），`awb_active` 决定这个环跑不跑。`SET_WB` 清 `awb_active` 那段注释是关键：

> Setting the gains is taking them over. A caller computing them itself must not have the driver's own loop overwrite them one frame later, and doing this as part of the same critical section is what leaves no window in which both are steering.

所以 `SET_WB`/`SET_AWB` 决定的是**谁在操舵**：驱动的环，还是应用的环。

## I2C 走的是另一条完全不同的路

```
camenc_set_ctrl(camfd, V4L2_CID_EXPOSURE_ABSOLUTE, ...)
camenc_set_ctrl(camfd, V4L2_CID_ISO_SENSITIVITY,  ...)
        └─ /dev/video0 的控制通道 → imgsensor → ov5647 → I2C
```

⇒ **AE 环其实跨两个设备**：输入在 `/dev/cam3a`，输出之一（曝光/增益）在 `camfd`，输出之二（WB）又回到 `/dev/cam3a`。

## 对我们第 4 点讨论的影响 —— 包括修正我自己上一轮的建议

**修正**：我上一轮说"给 cam3a 加 `.poll` 就能让 AE 与编码路径彻底解耦"，**这只对一半**。加 poll 只能解决"测量到货"的通知问题；AE 的**输出**（曝光/增益的 I2C）必须走 `camfd`，那是**采集设备**。所以线程4 无论如何都要碰采集设备的控制通道，摘不干净。

**由此多出一个新问题**：分线程后，线程4 在 `camfd` 上发 `VIDIOC_S_EXT_CTRLS`，线程2 在**同一个 fd** 上发 DQBUF/QBUF。今天单线程没这事，分线程就有了。

我去查了 `v4l2_cap.c`，**好消息**：`capture_dqbuf` 在等待时**并不持有 `cmng->mutex`**——2423-2427 只在估算采集状态时短暂持有，2430 才阻塞在信号量上。所以控制 ioctl 不会被停在那儿的 DQBUF 挡住。

不过我仍建议**让线程4 自己 open 一个 camfd 专门做控制**：把"谁在哪个 fd 上发什么"变成结构上明确的，而不是依赖框架内部的锁粒度。这属于"判据要落在结构上而不是依赖实现细节"。

**另外**：`GET_STATS`/`SET_WB` 与工作线程共用 `priv->irqlock`（`spin_lock_irqsave`，关中断自旋）。临界区很短，但它是**应用线程与线程1 之间唯一的共享锁**——"线程1 绝不阻塞"这条边界上，这是要盯着的一点。

## 附带：我上一轮留的那个待确认问题，答案找到了

我上一轮说"`STREAMOFF` 能否唤醒阻塞中的 `DQBUF`，这决定 quiesce 的形状"。查到了，答案很硬：

- `capture_dqbuf` 阻塞在 **`nxsem_wait_uninterruptible`** —— **不可中断**，信号也叫不醒。
- `capture_streamoff`（2788-2831）**只调 `change_capture_state`，根本不 post 那个信号量**。
- 唯一能主动让它返回的是 **`VIDIOC_DQCANCEL`** → `capture_cancel_dqbuf` → post + 置 `WAITEND_CAUSE_DQCANCEL` → DQBUF 返回 **`-ECANCELED`**。

⇒ **线程4 不能靠 STREAMOFF 把线程2 从 DQBUF 里拔出来。** quiesce 只有两条路：

| | 做法 | 性质 |
|---|---|---|
| 协作式 | 线程2 在帧首检查标志，决定不再停进去 | 常态路径，干净 |
| DQCANCEL | 线程4 显式打断，线程2 拿到 `-ECANCELED` | 兜底（已经停进去了，CLI 要求立刻切模式） |

我建议**两条都要**，而且 `-ECANCELED` 必须和真错误区分开，否则会被错误处理路径吞掉。

⚠ 还有**第二个阻塞点**：线程2 也会停在编码器的 `QBUF` 里等 VEPU ISR。那个**没有 DQCANCEL 对应物**，只能等它自然返回（≤ ~24ms）。quiesce 的等待上界要按它算，不能只考虑相机那一侧。

---

现在手上有三个可以直接落地的结论：**AE 输出必须跨两个 fd（建议线程4 独立开 camfd）**、**测量出口可以加 poll 但解决不了输出侧**、**quiesce 必须协作式 + DQCANCEL 兜底**。

The only ways out are:
1. A frame completes (capture done) → posts the semaphore.
2. `VIDIOC_DQCANCEL` from the application → `capture_cancel_dqbuf` → posts with `WAITEND_CAUSE_DQCANCEL` → DQBUF returns `-ECANCELED`.

################ 8748298 ################
cam: measure exposure in the demosaic, and hand the decision out

Automatic exposure, gain and white balance need three things that do not
belong in the same place: a measurement, a decision, and a mechanism.  This
is the measurement and the mechanism; the decision is the application's, in
app/camenc.

The measurement goes in the demosaic pass, which is already reading every
RAW sample, so a frame costs nothing extra to measure.  That is the lesser
reason.  The greater one is that it cannot be taken anywhere else: the sums
have to be taken *before* the white balance gains are applied, because a
loop that measured after would read its own output and settle on the square
root of the gain it was looking for -- and they cannot be recovered from the
output either, since a white balanced picture cannot tell a grey scene from
a strongly cast one.  Handing the application RAW instead would mean giving
up the fused single-pass demosaic or doing it twice.

The control plane is a device of its own rather than controls on
/dev/videoN, because exposure and gain are the sensor's and white balance is
the capture driver's, and the capture device's control path reaches only the
sensor.  Folding them together would need a gain stored in the sensor driver
that the sensor has no use for, or a sensor driver that knows about the
SoC's video block.

Measurement out: the channel sums, the sample count, and the gains in force.
The sums rather than a mean, because a caller that wants its own idea of
brightness should be able to compute one.  The count is what says how much
of the frame was clipped, since the demosaicer leaves out any block holding
a saturated sample.

White balance in, and setting it takes the gains away from the driver's own
loop -- two controllers on one register is one too many.

The sensor side gains the standard auto controls, off by default, so that
the sensor's own AEC can be selected by a caller that wants it.  Shutter and
aperture priority are refused rather than accepted: there is no iris, and
the sensor's loop drives exposure and gain together, so a fixed exposure
with a floating gain is a policy built on top of manual mode rather than a
mode this part has.

And the frame length is pinned manual in every configuration, which is a
change to the register table: 0x3503 gains its bit 2, and 0x350c/0x350d are
written as zero.  The datasheet asks for that zero when the host owns the
frame length, and the driver never wrote it -- the reset value is 1560.  It
is not being added today, which the measured 16000 us frame interval says
plainly enough, so nothing was broken; but the sensor's AEC is entitled to
lengthen a frame to integrate for longer, and a frame rate that the stream's
VUI promises and the application paces against should not be able to move
from inside the sensor where nothing can see it.

  → 返回 `-ENOTTY`。没有任何 vendor/private 透传。
- 芯片驱动的 vtable（`struct imgdata_ops_s`）成员只有 `init/uninit/set_buf/validate_frame_setting/start_capture/stop_capture/alloc/free`——**没有 ioctl 钩子**，所以即使框架愿意转发，也没有通道能送到 `rk3576_vicap.c`。
- ⇒ 要在 `/dev/video0` 上加自定义 ioctl，就得**改上游通用代码**：`v4l2_core.c` 的 switch + `imgdata_ops_s` 加一个 vtable 成员。而 `v4l2_core.c` 是 NuttX 上游文件（`git log` 里是 nuttx 的提交）。

⇒ 所以当时的选择实际是：**"改所有采集驱动共用的上游框架，去塞一颗芯片的私有接口" vs "新增一个设备"**。后者把芯片特有的接口留在自己的地盘上。

### 3. 而且 `cam3a.h` 自己的写法证明了作者就是这么想的
那段 ioctl base 的选择：
> 0x4700 is the first value past the block NuttX reserves for its own subsystems, which runs to 0x4600 and then resumes at 0x8b00 for network ioctls. Deriving one from a reserved base -- the usual out-of-tree choice, as _JOYBASE | 0x0040 -- would collide with the next command added to that subsystem, and this device is not that subsystem.

这段注释的隐含前提就是"**我是一个 out-of-tree 的私有接口，所以我要自己开一块不与任何人冲突的命名空间**"。如果它是加在 `/dev/video0` 上的自定义 ioctl，就不可能这样划地盘——它会落在 V4L2 的命名空间里，和上游的扩展直接竞争。

### 4. 一个附带的好处（不是当时的理由，但现在很值钱）
独立设备意味着线程4 可以**独立 open 它、独立阻塞/取数**，和 `/dev/video0` 的 DQBUF/QBUF 互不干扰。如果 3A 接口长在 `/dev/video0` 上，线程4 和线程2 就必然共享一个 fd 和一个框架状态机——正是我们前面讨论要避开的东西。

### 5. 顺带纠正我上一轮的一个错误
我上一轮把取消 DQBUF 的 ioctl 写成了 `VIDIOC_DQCANCEL`，**真名是 `VIDIOC_CANCEL_DQBUF`**（`nuttx/include/sys/videoio.h:1768`，`_VIDIOC(0x00c1)`）。机制和我说的一样，名字错了。

Then maybe: 这也回答了你可能的下一个问题——如果将来要让线程4 的测量通道可阻塞，是继续扩 cam3a（加 `.poll`），而不是回到 /dev/video0。

找到了，而且答案分两层——**文档里记的理由和你问的其实是两件事**。

## 第一层：文档记录的理由，针对的是 **V4L2 标准控制**

`cam3a.h` 里那节和引入它的提交 `8748298` 都只谈标准控制。提交原文：

> The control plane is a device of its own rather than controls on `/dev/videoN`, because exposure and gain are the sensor's and white balance is the capture driver's, and **the capture device's control path reaches only the sensor**. Folding them together would need a gain stored in the sensor driver that the sensor has no use for, or a sensor driver that knows about the SoC's video block.

所以理由是：`/dev/videoN` 的控制通道**只能到 sensor**。曝光/增益属于 sensor，走那里天然正确——**而且现在也仍然走那里**（头文件明说 "The ordinary V4L2 controls on /dev/videoN still work and are unaffected"）。但 WB 是去马赛克里的一个乘法，sensor 那边根本没有对应物。硬合并的两种下场，提交里都点名了。

## 第二层：自定义 ioctl —— **文档没写，但机械原因是硬的**

你问的"自定义 ioctl 直接加在 cam 设备上"是第三种选项，`cam3a.h` 没提它。我去查了框架，结论是**它加不上去，除非改上游通用代码**：

**1. `/dev/videoN` 的 ioctl 分发表是个固定 switch。**
`nuttx/drivers/video/v4l2_core.c` 的 `v4l2_ioctl()` 逐条 `case VIDIOC_*`，末尾：

```c
      default:
        verr("Unrecognized cmd: %d\n", cmd);
        break;
    }

  return -ENOTTY;
```

**没有任何 vendor/private 透传通道。**

**2. 芯片驱动的 vtable 里没有 ioctl 钩子。**
`struct imgdata_ops_s`（`nuttx/include/nuttx/video/imgdata.h`）的全部成员是：

```
init  uninit  set_buf  validate_frame_setting  start_capture  stop_capture  alloc  free
```

所以**即使框架愿意转发，也没有一条路能把它送到 `rk3576_vicap.c`**。

⇒ 要在 `/dev/video0` 上加一个自定义 ioctl，实际动作是：**改 `v4l2_core.c` 的 switch + 给 `imgdata_ops_s` 加一个 vtable 成员**——也就是改**所有采集驱动共用的那层框架**，去装一颗芯片的私有接口。

**所以当时真正的选择是**："改共用框架、把芯片私有接口塞进去" vs "新增一个设备"。后者把芯片特有的接口留在自己的地盘上。这个取舍和 `rk3576_vicap.c` 里 `.alloc`/`.free` 那种"框架已经给了钩子就直接用"是同一套判断——**能用现成钩子就用，需要动共用层就另开一个**。

## 作者自己的写法印证了这一点

`cam3a.h` 里选 ioctl base 的那段注释，隐含前提就是"我是个 out-of-tree 的私有接口，要自己划一块不与人冲突的命名空间"：

> 0x4700 is the first value past the block NuttX reserves for its own subsystems, which runs to 0x4600 and then resumes at 0x8b00 for network ioctls. Deriving one from a reserved base — **the usual out-of-tree choice**, as `_JOYBASE | 0x0040` — would collide with the next command added to that subsystem, and **this device is not that subsystem**.

如果这个接口长在 `/dev/video0` 上，就不可能这样划地盘——它会落在 V4L2 的命名空间里，直接和上游将来的扩展抢号。**这段注释只有在"独立设备"这个决定之下才写得出来**，可以看作决定的旁证。

## 一个当时不是理由、但对我们现在很值钱的副作用

独立设备让**线程4 可以独立 open、独立取数**，和线程2 在 `/dev/video0` 上的 DQBUF/QBUF 互不干扰。如果 3A 接口长在 `/dev/video0` 上，线程4 和线程2 就必然共享一个 fd 加一个框架状态机——正是我们前面想避开的东西。

不过要提醒一句：**这个好处只覆盖输入侧**。AE 的输出（曝光/增益的 I2C）按设计仍然必须走 `/dev/video0` 的控制通道，所以"线程4 独立 fd"这件事对输出侧依然要做，不能靠 cam3a 解决。

## 顺带纠正我上一轮的一个错误

我上一轮把取消 DQBUF 的 ioctl 写成了 `VIDIOC_DQCANCEL`。**真名是 `VIDIOC_CANCEL_DQBUF`**（`nuttx/include/sys/videoio.h:1768`，`_VIDIOC(0x00c1)`），机制和我描述的一致，名字是我记错了。

---

要把这两条结论（**框架无私有 ioctl 透传 → 独立设备是唯一不动通用层的选择**、**`VIDIOC_CANCEL_DQBUF` 是 quiesce 的兜底**）连同前面那三条一起写进记忆吗？还是继续往下挖？
